messages.subject: Time recording — November narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Our records show unposted time for November against several matters. Please can fee-earners ensure all November time is recorded and narratives completed by close of play Wednesday so we can run the December billing cycle. Partners, please approve your teams' drafts once posted.

Many thanks,
Finance / Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
